frd.goal: add Glossary configuration type with CRUD, versioning, prompt substitution, export/import, and agent binding

usecase.post: glossary stored with system-generated id and initial version
usecase.step: operator sends POST /glossarystore/glossaries with a list of terms, each term is a key-value pair
system validates every term key: up to 64 characters, lowercase, alphanumeric and underscore only
system generates a unique id, assigns initial version, and persists the glossary
system returns the generated id in the Location header

ext.outcome: glossary not created, operator received validation error naming the invalid term key

usecase.post: glossary data returned containing id, version, and terms
usecase.step: operator sends GET /glossarystore/glossaries to list all glossaries, or GET /glossarystore/glossaries/{id} to read one
system returns the glossary or list of glossaries with id, version, and terms

ext.outcome: glossary not returned, operator received absence response

usecase.goal: update glossary creating a new version
usecase.pre: operator is authenticated and glossary exists
usecase.post: new version of glossary stored with incremented version number
usecase.step: operator sends PUT /glossarystore/glossaries/{id} with updated terms
system validates every term key: up to 64 characters, lowercase, alphanumeric and underscore only
system increments the version and persists the updated glossary
system confirms the update

ext.outcome: update rejected, operator received absence response for unknown glossary id
update rejected, operator received validation error naming the invalid term key

usecase.pre: operator is authenticated and glossary exists
usecase.step: operator sends DELETE /glossarystore/glossaries/{id}
system removes the glossary from the store

ext.outcome: glossary not removed, operator received absence response for unknown glossary id

usecase.goal: bind or unbind glossary to agent configuration
usecase.pre: operator is authenticated and agent exists
usecase.post: agent configuration glossaries list updated, list order defines substitution priority
usecase.step: operator sends agent configuration update with glossary URI added to or removed from the glossaries list
system persists the updated agent configuration
system confirms the update

usecase.pre: agent configuration contains at least one glossary URI in its glossaries list and prompt contains at least one glossary placeholder in the glossary template namespace
usecase.post: all glossary placeholders in the prompt resolved with term values from bound glossaries
usecase.step: prompt rendering encounters a placeholder in the glossary template namespace
system reads the glossaries list from the agent configuration; only glossaries bound to this agent are eligible, no global fallback
system loads each bound glossary and resolves the term; on key collision across glossaries the last loaded wins, list order in agent configuration is priority
system substitutes the resolved value into the prompt

ext.outcome: prompt not rendered, rendering failed because a glossary referenced in agent configuration was removed from the store

usecase.goal: export glossary in agent ZIP archive
usecase.pre: agent has at least one glossary bound
usecase.post: agent ZIP archive contains glossary resource file and descriptor file for each bound glossary
usecase.step: operator triggers agent export
system generates a glossary resource file named {id}.glossary.json and a descriptor file named {id}.descriptor.json for each bound glossary
system includes the generated files in the agent ZIP archive

usecase.goal: import glossary from agent ZIP archive
usecase.pre: agent ZIP archive contains glossary resource files
usecase.post: glossary merged into store by resource URI, existing glossary upgraded to imported version
usecase.step: operator triggers agent import with a ZIP archive
system extracts glossary resource files from the ZIP
system merges each glossary by resource URI: if a glossary with the same URI already exists, the imported version upgrades the existing one

delta.to: create glossary with generated id, validate term keys, return Location header
list all glossaries or read one by id with version and terms
update glossary terms with version increment
store and retrieve glossary documents in MongoDB
load bound glossaries from agent config and substitute term values into prompt placeholders

scenario.before: no glossary CRUD endpoint exists; POST to glossary store path returns 404
scenario.after: POST /glossarystore/glossaries validates term keys, persists glossary with generated id, returns Location header
GET /glossarystore/glossaries returns glossary list or single glossary with id, version, and terms
PUT /glossarystore/glossaries/{id} validates terms, increments version, persists updated glossary
DELETE /glossarystore/glossaries/{id} removes glossary from MongoDB store

scenario.before: agent configuration has no glossaries field; glossary binding not possible
scenario.after: agent configuration update accepts glossaries URI list; list order defines substitution priority

scenario.before: glossary placeholders in prompts are not resolved; no glossary service exists
scenario.after: GlossaryService resolves glossary placeholders from bound glossaries; on key collision last in list wins

scenario.before: agent export does not include glossary files in ZIP
scenario.after: agent ZIP contains {id}.glossary.json and {id}.descriptor.json for each bound glossary

scenario.before: agent import ignores glossary files in ZIP archive
scenario.after: import extracts glossary files, merges by resource URI; UpgradeExecutor upgrades existing glossary to imported version

field.name: terms
field.domain: key-value pairs, no description, no category

field.name: key
field.domain: up to 64 chars, lowercase, alphanumeric and underscore

field.name: glossaries
field.domain: ordered list, position defines substitution priority

failure.client: request rejected with validation error naming the invalid term key
failure.operator: validation error message names the invalid term key

failure.client: absence response for REST calls; prompt rendering failure when bound glossary missing from store
failure.operator: glossary not found or was removed from store
